## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

JAKAL v4.0 has been successfully built as a complete **enterprise autonomous defense platform** with:

- **Multi-tenant MSP gateway** for managed service providers
- **Fleet management & RMM** for device orchestration
- **Vulnerability management** with CVE tracking & patch deployment
- **Advanced VR command center** with AI-augmented decision-making
- **Real-time A/V integration** with multi-modal threat detection
- **Sensor-triggered autonomy** for immediate response
- **Compliance automation** across NIST, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC2
- **Production security** with PQC encryption, RBAC, audit trails

All code is **immediately deployable** to production.

## DEPLOYMENT QUICK START

### Option 1: Local Development (Recommended for Testing)
```bash
# Clone and setup
git clone https://github.com/thepeoplesrealty100-ops/Enterprise-Application.git
cd Enterprise-Application
git checkout feat/v4-all

# Install dependencies
pip install -q fastapi uvicorn duckdb pydantic httpx

# Initialize database
python backend/database_schema_v4.py

# Start server
cd backend
python -m uvicorn app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

# Access
Browser: http://localhost:8000
API Docs: http://localhost:8000/docs
```

### Option 2: Docker Compose (Single-Host Production)
```bash
cd Enterprise-Application
docker compose up -d

# Check status
docker compose ps
docker compose logs -f backend

# Access
Browser: http://localhost:8000
```

### Option 3: Kubernetes (Multi-Cloud Production)
```bash
cd Enterprise-Application

# Deploy
kubectl apply -f k8s/jakal-backend-complete.yaml

# Verify
kubectl get pods -n jakal
kubectl port-forward -n jakal service/jakal-backend 8000:8000

# Access
Browser: http://localhost:8000
```

### Option 4: Automated Deployment Script
```bash
cd Enterprise-Application
python deploy.py

# Follows guided prompts for method selection
```

## SAMPLE API CALLS

### Fleet Management
```bash
# Get all devices
curl http://localhost:8000/api/fleet/devices

# Get device details
curl http://localhost:8000/api/fleet/devices/dev-001

# Run script on device
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/fleet/actions/run-script \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "device_ids": ["dev-001", "dev-002"],
    "script_id": "script-updates",
    "parameters": {}
  }'

# Deploy patch to group
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/fleet/groups/group-workstations/apply-policy \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"policy_id": "policy-critical-patches"}'
```

### Vulnerability Management
```bash
# Get CVE list
curl http://localhost:8000/api/vulnerabilities/cves

# Get CVE details
curl http://localhost:8000/api/vulnerabilities/cves/CVE-2024-3094

# Deploy patch
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/vulnerabilities/patches/patch-2024-3094-v1/deploy \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "device_ids": ["dev-002"],
    "schedule_time": null
  }'

# Get compliance status
curl http://localhost:8000/api/vulnerabilities/compliance/patch-status
```

### MSP Gateway
```bash
# List tenants
curl http://localhost:8000/api/msp/tenants

# Switch tenant
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/msp/tenants/switch \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id": "client-001"}'

# Get tenant details
curl http://localhost:8000/api/msp/tenants/client-001

# Broadcast operation
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/msp/operations/broadcast \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "operation_type": "patch_deployment",
    "source_tenant": "msp-001",
    "target_tenants": ["client-001", "client-002"],
    "payload": {"patch_id": "patch-2024-3094-v1"}
  }'
```
